description: Jo owns a portable sound system and must decide whether to accept Malik's barter proposal for its use at a neighborhood block party, rather than take another buyer's cash offer. Jo must finalize the exact cash adjustment, performance, equipment, and setup terms.

shared_context.S1: Jo's portable sound system is offered for $700.
shared_context.S2: Malik has proposed using the sound system at the neighborhood block party in exchange for a performance and a cash adjustment.
shared_context.S3: The block party is scheduled for Saturday, June 29, and the sound system appears to be in working order.
shared_context.S4: Jo makes the final call on the deal; before settling, Jo follows the usual practice of asking the proposer, any other interested party, and the event organizer to confirm practical terms.

PF1.text: Malik's exact barter offer is a four-hour performance from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. on Saturday, June 29, plus $150 in cash; Malik will also bring two wireless vocal microphones and his mixer.

PF2.text: Tessa is prepared to pay Jo $550 in cash and collect the sound system on Thursday, June 20.

PF3.text: Ren's event plan requires the sound system to be set up by 4:30 p.m. on June 29, with soundcheck finished by 5:30 p.m.; the event has no separate sound technician.

acceptance_conditions: Jo must choose the barter route.
The barter must include exactly $150 in cash from Malik.
Malik's performance must run from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. on June 29.
Two wireless vocal microphones and Malik's mixer must be included.
The sound system must be set up by 4:30 p.m. and soundcheck must be finished by 5:30 p.m.
Tessa's $550 cash alternative must be recorded before choosing the barter route.
Malik's exact barter offer must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'barter_terms' and c['target'] == 'Malik' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Malik's exact offer changes the cash adjustment to $150, fixes the performance at 6:00-10:00 p.m. on June 29, adds the two microphones and mixer, and supplies the terms commitment Jo must log and cite.
Tessa's specific $550 cash offer gives Jo a concrete alternative to record before selecting the barter route instead of making an ungrounded choice between vague options.
Ren's event requirements change the settlement from an unspecified setup to a 4:30 p.m. setup deadline and a 5:30 p.m. soundcheck deadline on June 29.
